message: I changed my mind about the cotton t-shirt pack from ORD-1028. Can I return it for a refund?

evidence.sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, delivery_date, product_name, category, unit_price, quantity, order_total, payment_method, status, final_sale FROM lightning.metastore.refundwise.refundwise_usl.orders WHERE customer_id = 'C002' AND order_id = 'ORD-1028'
SELECT refund_id, customer_id, order_id, request_date, amount, reason, decision FROM lightning.metastore.refundwise.refundwise_usl.refund_history WHERE customer_id = 'C002'

rows.rule_text: Unused items may be returned for a full refund within 30 days of delivery.
Items that arrive damaged or defective are refunded in full within 30 days of delivery; a photo is requested.
If an order has not been delivered 14 days after the order date, the customer may choose a refund or a replacement.
Items marked final sale cannot be refunded unless they are defective.
Any refund above 200.00 must be reviewed by a support lead before approval.
Customers with 3 or more refunds in the last 90 days are sent to human review to check for abuse.
An order can be refunded only once. Requests for an order that was already refunded are rejected.
When the customer's claim conflicts with order or carrier records, the case goes to human review.

proposed_decision.rationale: R1 approves unused items returned within 30 days of delivery, but the checks report days_since_delivery as 31 (E1: delivered 2026-09-24, today 2026-10-25), so the 30-day changed-mind window has expired. No other rule approves a changed-mind refund outside that window.

critique.reason: The reject decision is correct. R1 (E3) approves changed-mind returns only within 30 days of delivery, but the Python checks report days_since_delivery = 31 and E1 confirms delivery on 2026-09-24, so the window has expired. No other rule applies: not final sale, $34.50 is under the $200 limit, only 1 prior approved refund in 90 days, and the order was not already refunded. All factual claims agree with the Python checks, which take precedence.

customer_reply: Thank you for contacting us about ORD-1028. We’re sorry, but we’re unable to issue a refund for the cotton t-shirt pack because it was delivered on 2026-09-24, which is 31 days ago—outside our 30-day changed-mind return window. Since the return window has expired, we cannot approve this request.
limitations: Item condition (unused/defective) was not independently verified beyond the order status.
Return window is based solely on the delivery date recorded in E1; actual receipt by the customer may vary.
